overview: A dark-themed mobile-first personal finance tracker for recording income and expenses by category, with a live balance summary and category spending analysis.
features: Register income and expenses with amount, category and date
See your total available balance update instantly
Track income and expense totals separately
Bar chart and progress bars showing spending per category
Highlight of the category where you spent the most
Dark interface with green and grey tones
Bottom navigation between Summary, Register and Analysis
